scenes.say: Does using your phone in the dark make you go blind? Let's check the myth, and the facts.

scenes.en: Using a phone in the dark damages your eyes forever.
scenes.say: Myth: using a phone in a dark room will permanently damage your eyes. There's no good evidence for that.

scenes.en: It does cause strain: dry, tired eyes and headaches.
scenes.say: Fact: it does cause eye strain. A bright screen in a dark room keeps your pupils adjusting, and you blink less. So eyes feel dry, tired and achy.

scenes.en: Bright screen light late at night can delay sleep.
scenes.say: Did you know? Bright screen light late at night can delay your body's sleep signal, so you fall asleep later, and wake up with tired eyes.

scenes.en: Room light on. Brightness down. Phone at least 30 cm away.
scenes.ta: அறை விளக்கை போடுங்கள், போனை தள்ளி வையுங்கள்
scenes.say: Keep a room light on, turn the screen brightness down, and hold the phone at least thirty centimetres away.

scenes.en: Fewer screens after dark. More outdoor time in daylight.
scenes.say: For children, limit screens after dark, and give them more time outdoors in daylight. That's good for growing eyes.

scenes.en: Eye pain, blur that won't clear, or daily headaches.
scenes.ta: வலி, தொடர் மங்கல் இருந்தால் கண் பரிசோதனை செய்யுங்கள்
scenes.say: If you have eye pain, blur that doesn't clear, or daily headaches, get your eyes checked. Book an eye test today.
